summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _Reader and _ReaderContext helpers, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file with overloads); tests/test_progress.py (16 new tests before the __main__ block); docs/source/progress.rst (two new subsections under Advanced usage); CHANGELOG.md (one Added entry, PR 1759). The diff is additions only. Nothing was run or committed, per the instructions. Known gaps: _Reader.readinto calls handle.readinto on a handle typed BinaryIO, which lacks readinto in typeshed, so a type checker will flag it; I removed an ignore comment rather than hide it. Some public docstring lines exceed 88 columns, matching the existing track() docstring. Design calls: the text/binary decision uses the raw mode string, so 'tr' returns binary; Progress.open creates the task before opening the file, as specified, so an open failure can leave a task behind; the module-level open shadows the builtin inside progress.py, so Progress.open uses io.open.
